exercises.title: Lab 8 — Tools and Automation for LabBook Reminders
exercises.problemHtml:
Lab 8 — Tools and Automation for LabBook Reminders

Chapter 8 lab · unit tests with mocks (Mockito style), pyramid and CI stages, tool types, automation business case · 10 marks

1. Overview

A. Unit tests with mocks. Every hour a job calls ReminderService.sendReminders(): it asks the repository for bookings starting 23–25 hours from now, e-mails each CONFIRMED booking that was not reminded yet (“Reminder: your lab starts tomorrow”, with the booking code) and marks it as reminded; it returns the number of reminders sent. HOUR is given in lib/sut.js.

class ReminderService {
  constructor(repo, mailer, clock) {
    this.repo = repo;
    this.mailer = mailer;
    this.clock = clock;
  }

  // Sends "Reminder: your lab starts tomorrow" for bookings starting 23–25 hours from now.
  sendReminders() {
    const now = this.clock.now();
    const due = this.repo.findStartingBetween(now + 23 * HOUR, now + 25 * HOUR);
    let sent = 0;
    for (const b of due) {
      if (b.status !== 'CONFIRMED' || b.reminded) continue;
      this.mailer.send(b.email, 'Reminder: your lab starts tomorrow', b.code);
      this.repo.markReminded(b.code);
      sent++;
    }
    return sent;
  }
}

Write tests.js with mocks of the repository, the mailer and the clock (JUnit 5 + Mockito in Java; jest.fn() here). The grader kills 8 faulty versions (5 listed, 3 hidden).

B. Pyramid and pipeline. S1 JUnit tests of ReminderService with mocks (2 s in total) · S2 REST Assured tests of the booking API against a test database (4 min) · S3 Selenium journeys “book → cancel → promoted” in three browsers (55 min) · S4 Jest tests of the WaitList and refund functions (1 s). Give each suite its pyramid layer and its CI stage (the pre-merge gate must stay under 10 minutes).

C. Tools. N1 Know which branches of ReminderService the tests executed · N2 Generate 50,000 anonymised bookings for a load test · N3 Simulate 300 students booking at 07:00 on Monday · N4 Block a merge when new code has a critical code smell · N5 Run S1, S2 and S4 automatically on every push · N6 Alert the team when the production error rate jumps.

D. Business case for automating S3: manual run 300 min; scripting 3,000 min once; each automated run 30 min of supervision + 40 min of script maintenance. Compute the break-even number of runs and the ROI after 50 runs (1 decimal), and name the risk that most often breaks such a business case.

Main features

  • A. A mock-based unit test suite for ReminderService.
  • B. Layer and stage of four suites.
  • C. Tool type for six needs.
  • D. Break-even, ROI and the main risk.

General requirements

  • Do not declare ReminderService or HOUR in tests.js — the grader provides them.

2. Required project structure

lib/testkit.js           ← Jest-like runner (do not edit)
lib/sut.js               ← const HOUR
tests.js                 ← Part A
answers/b-pipeline.js    ← const PIPELINE = { S1: { layer, stage }, … }
answers/c-tools.js       ← const TOOLS = { N1: '…', … }
answers/d-business.js    ← const BUSINESS = { breakEven, roi50, mainRisk }

4. Functional requirements

1. A1 Mocks — listed defects 4 marks

Requirements:

  • A valid suite (≥ 7 tests) that kills M1–M5.

Must use: test doubles unit test framework

2. A2 Mocks — hidden defects 1 mark

Requirements:

  • Three more interaction defects.

Must use: test doubles

3. B–C. Pipeline and tools 3 marks

Requirements:

  • Eight + six values.

Must use: test pyramid tool classification

4. D. Business case 2 marks

Requirements:

  • Break-even, ROI, main risk.

Must use: cost-benefit

Common deductions

  • Asserting only the returned count — a version that never marks bookings as reminded returns the same count.
  • Putting the 55-minute Selenium suite in the pre-merge gate.

7. Submission

Write your answers in the answer files on the right (they mirror the official template: one JavaScript object per test case / issue). Press Run for the visible checks and Submit for full grading, hidden checks included. Your score per question appears in the rubric table.

Lab 8 — Tools and Automation for LabBook Reminders

Lab chương 8 · unit test có mock (kiểu Mockito), kim tự tháp và stage CI, loại công cụ, luận chứng tự động hoá · 10 điểm

1. Tổng quan

A. Mỗi giờ một job gọi ReminderService.sendReminders(): hỏi repository các booking bắt đầu sau 23–25 giờ, gửi thư nhắc cho booking CONFIRMED chưa được nhắc (kèm mã) và đánh dấu đã nhắc; trả số thư đã gửi. Viết tests.js với mock của repository, mailer và clock (Java: JUnit 5 + Mockito). Máy chấm giết 8 phiên bản lỗi (5 công khai, 3 ẩn). B. Tầng kim tự tháp và stage CI cho S1–S4 (cổng trước khi merge phải dưới 10 phút). C. Loại công cụ cho N1–N6. D. Luận chứng tự động hoá S3: chạy tay 300 phút; viết script 3.000 phút một lần; mỗi lần chạy tự động 30 phút giám sát + 40 phút bảo trì script — tính số lần hoà vốn, ROI sau 50 lần (1 chữ số) và rủi ro hay phá luận chứng nhất.

Chức năng chính

  • A. Bộ unit test dùng mock cho ReminderService.
  • B. Tầng và stage của bốn bộ test.
  • C. Loại công cụ cho sáu nhu cầu.
  • D. Hoà vốn, ROI và rủi ro chính.

Yêu cầu chung

  • Không khai báo ReminderService hay HOUR trong tests.js — máy chấm cung cấp.

  • Chỉ kiểm số trả về — bản không đánh dấu đã nhắc trả cùng số.

7. Nộp bài

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: A: interaction checks (window, recipient, subject, code, markReminded, never for CANCELLED/PENDING/already reminded, count of sent mails, one clock read). B: S1 unit/push · S2 integration/push · S3 UI/nightly · S4 unit/push. C: coverage · test data · performance · static analysis · CI · monitoring. D: break-even 14 runs (3,000 ÷ 230 = 13.04 → 14); ROI after 50 runs (15,000 − 6,500) ÷ 6,500 = 130.8%; the usual killer is underestimated maintenance.
